targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['name'] AS tool, countIf(LogAttributes['success']='true') AS succeeded, countIf(LogAttributes['success']='false') AS failed, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 1) AS avg_duration_ms FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='tool_result' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY succeeded + failed DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, LogAttributes['decision'] AS decision, LogAttributes['source'] AS source, count() AS count FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='tool_decision' GROUP BY tool, decision, source ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['model'] AS model, count() AS requests, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens'])) AS input_tokens, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS output_tokens, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tokens, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 1) AS avg_duration_ms FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='api_request' GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['status_code'] AS status_code, LogAttributes['error'] AS error, count() AS occurrences FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='api_error' GROUP BY status_code, error ORDER BY occurrences DESC
SELECT count() AS prompts FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='user_prompt'
SELECT round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['prompt_length'])), 0) AS avg_prompt_length FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='user_prompt'
SELECT LogAttributes['event.name'] AS event, count() AS occurrences FROM otel.otel_logs GROUP BY event ORDER BY occurrences DESC
